description.purpose: The single durable surface of the hive: the three-level memory ladder (episodes -> facts/entities/edges -> beliefs) with bi-temporal validity, plus the embedding generations and the four machine tables the lanes keep their state in (pending_extraction, consolidation_log, recall_scratch, scratch).
description.use_when: Every lane of the hive writes and reads here; no cell keeps private state (code cells have none by design).
description.not_in_scope: No joins, no aggregates and no graph/vector legs (traverse and similar are P4). Nothing is ever deleted: supersession sets expired_at + superseded_by, belief retraction sets active=0. FTS indexes exist only for tables declared in params.schema — a table created at runtime via create_table cannot carry one.
description.emits_meaning: messages[]: one tool_result per op; select and search return the projected row array as JSON text, search adds a bm25 `rank` per row (smaller is better). hop.operation drives the lane state machines, hop.rows_affected carries the RMW guard signal (a guarded update that affected 0 rows means another worker won), hop.error_code surfaces SQL failures as normal results.
description.consumes_meaning: messages[]: tool_call turns with store-native args {operation, table, ...}; select and search need an explicit columns array. where accepts comparison operators (eq/neq/lt/lte/gt/gte/in/is_null/or_null) besides bare equality, plus order_by and limit. The lane that a reply belongs to is carried by context.store_origin ('episode' | 'extract' | 'inline' | 'recall' | 'dream'), promoted by the edge that sent the op.
examples: {operation: insert, table: episodes, row: {...}} -> tool_result 'ok', hop {operation: 'insert', rows_affected: 1}
as-of query: {operation: select, table: facts, columns: [...], where: {valid_from: {lte: T}, valid_until: {or_null: {gt: T}}}} -> only the facts true at T
{operation: update, table: pending_extraction, set: {status: 'claimed', batch_id: 'b1'}, where: {status: 'pending'}} -> hop.rows_affected > 0 means this worker owns the batch
NULL means open: facts.expired_at NULL = live, facts.valid_until NULL = currently true, embeddings.blob NULL = not embedded yet (queued via status)
scratch: the join-less store cannot return two result sets at once, so a lane that must diff set A against set B parks both under one key and reads them back in a single select
